title: The Panth Furnishes the Sirhind Memorial

blocks.text: Once the plan is accepted, the Khalsa moves from proposal to institution. The Panth gathered there in ceremony, turning the site into a formal space of assembly rather than a merely remembered ruin.

The page describes the furnishing of that space with a platform, canopy, lit lamps, recitation, and appointed service. Weapons and devotional music alike help frame the memorial as a living extension of Guru-centered presence within the Panth.
What emerges is not a simple monument but a functioning shrine. Ritual, attendance, and endowed support together make remembrance part of daily discipline rather than a one-time gesture.
